title: YouTubeBannerSpecification
description: Schema for generating and parameterizing premium YouTube channel art in the YouTube Banner Maker utility.

channel_title.description: Primary creator or brand headline (e.g. 'VELOCITY AGENCY', 'KAI NAKAMURA').

tagline.description: Primary value proposition (e.g. 'Scaling 8-Figure DTC Brands with Paid Acquisition').

category_kicker.description: Micro category tag above title (e.g. 'B2B GROWTH', 'BOARDROOM STRATEGY', 'ESSAYS & ARCHITECTURE').

badge_items.description: Array of 2-4 pill labels displayed in the safe area (e.g. ['PYTHON', 'PYTORCH', 'LANGGRAPH']).

schedule_or_proof.description: Publishing schedule or credibility statement (e.g. 'NEW VIDEOS EVERY SUNDAY', '$50M+ MANAGED SPEND').

location_or_specs.description: Optional secondary metadata (e.g. 'LONDON • TOKYO', '45°50'01" N, 6°51'54" E').

photo_url.description: Optional URL to transparent PNG cutout of the creator or brand hero asset.
